title: Desk Guidance — Credit Held for a Booked In-Person Visit, Patient Financial Account
content:
Part of a credit on the Patient Financial Account is kept on the account for a booked in-person visit, as the patient's In-Person Appointments records show:

- when an Advanced Imaging Appointment or an In-Office Procedure Visit is booked, 150.00 is kept;
- when a Specialist Consultation is booked and neither of those is, 75.00 is kept;
- otherwise nothing is kept for a booked visit.

What is kept stays on the account as a credit and is not refunded.

## Points of judgement

| Booked In-Person Appointments on the handling date | Kept |
|---|---|
| an Advanced Imaging Appointment (with or without other visits) | 150.00 |
| an In-Office Procedure Visit (with or without other visits) | 150.00 |
| a Specialist Consultation and no imaging or procedure visit | 75.00 |
| only other visit types, or none booked | nothing |

- "Booked" is the appointment status on the In-Person Appointments record; a visit that has been completed, cancelled or missed is not booked.
- The amount kept is one figure for the account, not one per visit: two booked imaging appointments keep 150.00.

**Hypothetical example.** A patient with a credit of 400.00, a booked Specialist Consultation and a booked Nurse Visit: 75.00 is kept for the booked visit.
